  • 日本語名: ドキドキスロットパニック
  • 英語名: Dokidoki Slot Panic

别名

  • Doki Doki Slot Panic

あらすじ

Main character is a university student who is bored with his life. One day he sees an announcement of pachinko tournament with a nice sum of money as main prize. He reads the book with winning strategies and heads to the place of tournament. There are still 3 days before the competition, but cute girls willing to compete have already gathered at the place.
